_comment: The stamped LINKED tier: how many matched translation units actually reach the
PC port's binary. This is a STAMP, not a live counter, and it cannot be anything
else from main: port/tools/linkage.py reads build/port/walk_window.map, which only
exists after an MSVC build of the port, and CI on main has no such build.
BEFORE STAMPING, LOOK FOR A BUILD THAT ALREADY EXISTS. Every port lane carries its
own build tree, so a current walk_window.map is usually already on disk:
ls -la */build/port/walk_window.map
across the port worktrees, newest first, then run the tool against that root. The
first version of this file was stamped off a five-day-old branch while a map from
the night before sat unread one directory away, and published 26.5% when the real
figure was 34.5%. A stale stamp is still a real measurement, just of the wrong run.
To refresh: run `python port/tools/linkage.py [root]` and update the numbers below
together with branch, commit and measuredAt. Never move the count without also
moving the provenance fields - tools/tiers.py drops a stamp missing any of them,
which is the intended behaviour for a number nobody can trace.
basis records what the figure is a measurement OF. The port branches are not merged,
so this is the best single lane rather than a combined total. All seven live lanes,
lk5 3819. Overlapping but not identical seats, so the merged figure is higher and
the published number stays a floor.
LINKED grows when matched TUs become reachable in the port's linked call graph.
Actor methods and free functions both count. Enrollment alone does not increase
the count when the release build still dead-strips the unreachable object.
basis: integration branch port/link100 at its pushed tip 3d8374ff7, measured against that tip's own battery build walk_window.map (C:/tmp/l1-int, gate INT16: tree clean, reconfigure with CONFIGURE DEPS 253/5, battery ALL GREEN at floor 10216 with all 51 level and 36 scene rows and every smoke target, eight proofs green including the opening-cutscene gate, the card thread created by the ROM's own bring-up, the loopback session and the stage seat proof, a captured run showing the ROM's FS_Init reading the cartridge header through the shared-memory mirror), and confirmed by the hosted-runner port-linkage workflow on every push of port/** and every pull request into the shipping branch (a GitHub Windows machine with no cartridge; the shipping branch takes landings only through such pull requests, with the count required by a branch rule). +11 over the previous stamp of 10216, +194 over the 2026-09-08 morning's 10033, +1106 over the 2026-08-30 stamp of 9121. Since the 10216 stamp, one gated lane: the ROM's own NitroFS initialisation and the registration and cartridge-lock group behind it (+11), off a cartridge-header mirror the port had mapped all along and never written; the cartridge-lock pairs the ROM takes around every archive read now run as ROM code. The card driver band below it is refused body by body (a sleeper on a card interrupt the host has no source for). Gated rungs since the last stamp: 10216 -> 10227. Staged behind the next gate: the four-player rollback fix (match-end state carried across a rewind, 0), the configure speed-up (0), the four-player proof's settled-frame bound (0). Running: the hosted wireless stub (rung W4, up to +121) and the frame-loop duties moving into the ROM's VBlank wait (the prerequisite for the +72 loop handover).
